title: MapView caps properties query at $top=2000 -- silent truncation above that
detail: Line 63: `$top=2000` -- hardcoded cap. Current scale is ~150 locations so not an issue. But if a customer onboards with 2500 sites, the map silently drops the last 500. No UI indication. Latent data-completeness risk.
recommendedFix: Keep the cap but add a warning banner when the result is exactly 2000: `if (locs.length === 2000) toast.show('warn', 'Map showing first 2000 locations -- filter by customer to see the rest');`.

title: MapView popup HTML injects raw location/customer names without escaping -- XSS vector
detail: Lines 136-142: Leaflet popup content is built via template literal string interpolation: `${l.dcfg_name || l.dcfg_address}`, `${custName}`, etc. These values come from Dataverse and are injected directly into an HTML string passed to Leaflet's bindPopup(). If a location name contains `<script>` or other HTML, it will execute in the popup context. Leaflet's bindPopup accepts either a string (rendered as HTML) or a DOM element. Using string HTML with unescaped user data is an XSS risk.
evidence: MapView.jsx:134-143 -- template literal popup with `${l.dcfg_name}`, `${custName}`, `${l.dcfg_contact_person}` injected as raw HTML.
recommendedFix: Either (a) create popup content via DOM API instead of HTML string, or (b) add an escapeHtml utility that converts <>&'" to entities and wrap all interpolated values: `escapeHtml(l.dcfg_name)`. Option (a) is more robust.

title: MapView toast dependency missing from useEffect deps -- lint warning and stale closure risk
detail: Line 97: `}, []);` -- the useEffect on line 56 uses `toast` in its body (line 77 and 91) but `toast` is not in the dependency array. Since useToast returns a stable ref this is unlikely to cause bugs in practice, but it's a React exhaustive-deps lint violation.
evidence: MapView.jsx:56-97 -- useEffect uses toast at :77 and :91 but deps array on :97 is `[]`.
recommendedFix: Add toast to the dependency array or annotate with an eslint-disable comment if intentionally omitted.
